def starts_one_ends(n):
    if n < 1:
        return 0
    count_starting_with_1 = 10**(n - 1)  # Numbers starting with 1
    count_ending_with_1 = 10**(n - 1)     # Numbers ending with 1
    count_both = 10**(n - 2) if n > 1 else 0  # Numbers starting and ending with 1 (double counted)
    return count_starting_with_1 + count_ending_with_1 - count_both
